meetings.title: Blossom Inners <> BIK - Dragon flow integration

blossominners.business_context: Shopify store working with BIK on an abandoned-flow setup through the Shop Flow checkout integration (Dragon flow). Two earlier onboarding calls were silent with no summary.

pain_points.text: Login to Shop Flow was delayed because OTP/authentication messages did not arrive.
An earlier integration attempt was reportedly blocked by a bug on BIK's side.

stated_goals.text: Get the abandoned-flow tracking live through the Shop Flow integration.

open_items.text: Customer to complete Shop Flow login/OTP and approve the Shopify collaboration-access request BIK sends.
BIK to complete or validate the remaining integration work once access is approved.

risk_flags: Earlier integration attempt reportedly blocked by a BIK-side bug; resolution status not confirmed in meetings

meetings.title: Neenu’s Natural <> BIK - Dragon flows integration

Neenu's Natural Retail.business_context: Shopify brand using the Shop Flow checkout app alongside BIK; has an in-house tech lead and works with an agency. Abandoned-cart tracking of anonymous users is being set up via Dragon flows.

pain_points.text: Team is unhappy with the Shop Flow backend: glitches and poor checkout performance.
Wants a smoother checkout experience and pushed for a two-month trial of Go Quick.
Concern about data-sharing compliance under upcoming DPDP rules.

stated_goals.text: Track anonymous users for abandoned-cart recovery via the Dragon flows integration.

open_items.text: Customer to install the Shop Flow app and Chrome extension and enable the webhook; BIK to verify tracking and update the WhatsApp group (14 Jul).
BIK to set up a technical follow-up with the customer's tech lead and agency on Shop Flow backend concerns (29 Jun); status unknown.
BIK to share technical comparison of Shop Flow vs Go Quick (iOS user identification, segmentation, data flow) (29 Jun); status unknown.

risk_flags: Customer team showed strong resistance to Shop Flow and leaned toward switching to Go Quick (29 Jun)

Lo! Foods.business_context: Food brand using BIK for WhatsApp broadcasts, including B2B broadcasting; small ops team (attendee emails use a different company domain, bajofoods.com).

pain_points.text: Rujuhitha was denied access when logging into the BIK dashboard.
Unclear responsibilities across the team for managing broadcasts.
Needs templates created before running broadcast campaigns.

stated_goals.text: Have a structured approach to broadcasting messages, owned by Rujuhitha.

open_items.text: Customer to create a template for B2B broadcasting.
Add Praneeth to the support group.

Harissons.business_context: Bags brand on Shopify (Shop Flow checkout) using BIK WhatsApp and email campaigns, COD and abandoned-checkout flows, Razorpay for payments, and a retainer with BIK. Brand team handles templates and flows, with BIK support through a WhatsApp group.

pain_points.text: Disconnected its number from BIK mainly because AI calling and chatbot pricing was too high, though satisfied with the platform and support.
Prepaid payment confirmations blocked because the Razorpay webhook was not added.
Low campaign conversions and delivery limitations.
Abandoned-checkout messages not triggering or delayed due to Shop Flow integration issues; concern about upcoming charges for capturing anonymous users.
Needed clarity on campaign cost (14.9 lakhs) vs attributed revenue (3.8 lakhs); reporting lacks message-delivery granularity.

stated_goals.text: Offer COD customers a 5% discount to pay prepaid inside WhatsApp.
Get a bundled package of core platform, AI calling and website chat agent within the existing retainer.
Use AI voice calling and chatbot to handle customer queries and abandoned carts (tested in June).
Refresh abandoned-checkout WhatsApp templates and flows.

open_items.text: BIK to send a bundled pricing proposal (AI calling plus Manifest chatbot) within 1-2 days of 13 Oct; customer will then decide whether to stay or switch.
Customer to share budget expectations for AI usage and calls.
Sudarshan to verify feature differences and earlier client feedback comparing BIK and Convert Way.
Customer to add Razorpay webhook, create templates without cancel button and place test orders (28 Sep); status unknown.
BIK team to review the customer's C2P journey link (28 Sep); status unknown.

risk_flags: Churn: customer disconnected its number from BIK on pricing grounds and is deciding between BIK and Convert Way (13 Oct)
Open commercial negotiation pending BIK package proposal
